method: A reviewer read router instructions and relevant canonical skill descriptions and bodies. These are expected model choices, not results from a deterministic routing implementation or executed host trials.

cases.prompt: Design a distinctive frontend for a local ceramics studio. Start with typography, palette, hierarchy and layout.
cases.context: New substantive task; no previously selected workflow or design system.
expected_behaviors: Pin main to one full commit before reading the index and canonical entrypoint.
Prefer the direct aesthetic-direction match; do not load several overlapping design skills.
Respect the ceramics brief when selecting the visual direction.

cases.prompt: Implement an accessible responsive settings form in our existing React app, with keyboard navigation and validation states.
cases.context: Existing app has accepted design tokens and component conventions.
expected_behaviors: Preserve existing conventions and design tokens.
Use the focused engineering workflow; do not impose a new visual identity.
Read only relevant supports and verify the actual app runtime.

cases.prompt: Checkout started returning a 500 after yesterday's deploy. Find and fix the root cause.
cases.context: New substantive debugging task with repository and logs available.
expected_behaviors: Select the direct debugging workflow without first entering using-agent-skills.
Preserve evidence, reproduce, diagnose and verify the fix.
Do not treat a successful skill fetch as successful debugging.

cases.prompt: Model a simple editable coffee mug in Blender and save the blend file with a preview render.
cases.context: No bridge or provider selected; saved-file work is acceptable.
expected_behaviors: Choose the general Blender workflow over integration-specific alternatives.
Discover Blender and its version; use native bpy if appropriate.
Save an editable artifact and inspect the resulting render.

cases.prompt: Rebuild this toy train photo as an editable Blender model and compare renders against the reference.
cases.context: Readable image is attached; no generation provider selected.
expected_behaviors: Use the focused reconstruction workflow.
Load pinned reference-analysis, camera and execution guidance when needed.
Separate observed geometry, inferred hidden surfaces and visual fidelity from render execution.

cases.prompt: Export my saved Blender character to GLB for Three.js without losing its walk animation.
cases.context: Saved blend path is supplied; editable source must be retained.
expected_behaviors: Use the focused browser asset handoff workflow.
Preserve source and animation requirements.
Verify the exported GLB in the intended consumer rather than claiming success from file creation.

cases.prompt: Build a Blender sidebar add-on that validates selected assets before export.
cases.context: Target Blender version and asset rules are available.
expected_behaviors: Choose the focused add-on workflow.
Inspect actual asset rules and separate validation from mutations.
Verify registration, reload, error cases and export enforcement.

cases.prompt: Inspect the active UEFN level with Toolbelt and list the devices already in it.
cases.context: No local Toolbelt installation has yet been verified on this host.
expected_behaviors: Discover actual Toolbelt capabilities and verify ping plus intended level before editor work.
Treat historical Windows paths and old live-test records as source history, not proof about this host.
If Toolbelt is unavailable, name the missing capability without inventing tools or switching bridges.

cases.prompt: Use $blender-studio to make a stylized game prop.
cases.context: The named DSI workflow is remote and not already selected as an installed native skill.
expected_behaviors: Honor the named workflow, pin source and fetch its canonical entrypoint directly.
Load only the useful specialist guides.
Do not route again through sibling or umbrella workflows.

cases.context: frontend-design is already installed and explicitly selected in the host.
expected_behaviors: Follow the explicitly selected installed skill immediately.
Do not require extra remote discovery or create a router loop.

cases.prompt: Generate a short product video through inference.sh.
cases.context: Provider choice is explicit; belt CLI access is not yet verified.
expected_behaviors: Preserve inference.sh and verify belt runtime, authentication and current app schema.
Do not switch to Arcads when the selected provider is unavailable.
Separate prompt planning, retrieval, submission and reviewed output.
Respond normally; do not fetch the library or invoke its router.

cases.context: Continuation of a UI task with frontend-ui-engineering loaded at a retained full commit.
expected_behaviors: Continue the loaded workflow without a new routing pass.
Reuse its retained source revision and accepted design decisions.

cases.prompt: Use the DSI library to debug this failed build.
cases.context: GitHub commit resolution fails and no approved local source adapter is available.
expected_behaviors: Report that current source access is unavailable.
Snapshot descriptions may suggest debugging-and-error-recovery but must not be presented as retrieved current instructions.
Name the missing capability and continue useful independent diagnosis within existing authorization.
Do not silently use a different source or claim fresh-host routing success.
